Marketplace review -- SoundWave Pro Earbuds -- 2 stars
By GrumpyGamer22, posted February 3, 2026:
"Ordered these on January 5, package finally showed up January 20 (15 days shipping, come
on). The earbuds cut out constantly. I reached out on February 2 asking for a refund and
first got told I was 'past the window.' Feels like a scam honestly, don't buy from this
brand."

Seller reply (verified seller account), posted February 4, 2026:
"We're sorry for the frustration and for the earlier miscommunication. Per marketplace
electronics policy, returns must be requested within 21 days of the DELIVERY date, not the
order date. Our records show your order was delivered January 20, and your refund request
on February 2 was 13 days after delivery -- well within our 21-day window. We've corrected
the earlier error and processed your refund in full."

questions.instruction: Was GrumpyGamer22's February 2 refund request made within the marketplace's 21-day return window?
questions.notes: Window runs from delivery (Jan 20), not order date; Jan 20 + 21 days = Feb 10; the Feb 2 request is 8 days before that deadline -> within window, despite the initial (wrong) denial.

questions.instruction: Per the seller's reply, what date starts the 21-day return window?

candidates.description: The date the order was placed
The date the order was delivered
The date the review was posted
The date the refund was requested

questions.notes: The seller explicitly states the window is measured from delivery, not the order date -- the order date is a distractor that would make the request look late (Jan 5 + 21 = Jan 26, before Feb 2).

questions.instruction: Which of the following are true about this return?

candidates.description: The refund request was made within 21 days of the delivery date
The refund request was made within 21 days of the order date
The original 'past the window' denial was factually correct
Shipping (order to delivery) took 15 days

questions.notes: Delivery-based window: Feb 2 is within it (true). Order-date-based: Jan 5+21=Jan 26, Feb 2 is after that (false). Original denial was wrong (false). Jan 5 to Jan 20 is 15 days (true, incidental fact).
